articles.title: Trump says it’s “time for Ukraine to get new President” as Zelensky condemns diesel deal | BBC News
articles.titleZh: 特朗普表示，随着泽伦斯基谴责柴油协议， “乌克兰是时候换新总统了” |英国广播公司新闻
articles.summary:
Donald Trump has said "it's time for Ukraine to get a new President”, as he responded to Volodymyr Zelensky's criticism of a US deal with Russia to release large quantities of diesel fuel onto the global market.

The Ukrainian president warned that the deal would provide Moscow with money to continue its war against his nation, calling it a gift to Russian President Vladimir Putin.

Trump told reporters outside the White House on Saturday that Zelensky "wants to make problems for the world" by continuing to authorise attacks on Russian refineries.  "He'd better damn well stop," Trump said, before suggesting Ukraine should "get a new leader who can make a deal".

Global fuel supplies, including diesel, have been severely limited by the war against Iran launched by the US and Israel, which led to the effective closure of the Strait of Hormuz, through which roughly a fifth of the world's oil products usually flows.

Russia - a major producer - and Ukraine have recently intensified their strikes on each other's energy infrastructure and transport facilities, further straining energy markets.

Putin's envoy Kirill Dmitriev described Trump's intervention as "iconic and historic", saying that Ukraine "needs leadership actually focused on peace".

Ukraine’s President Volodymyr Zelensky reacted to the deal by saying it would allow Moscow to raise new funds to source new military equipment to continue the war.

Reeta Chakrabarti presents BBC News at Ten reporting by Joe Inwood and Dan Johnson.

articles.readingTextZh:
唐纳德·特朗普（ Donald Trump ）在回应沃洛基米尔·泽伦斯基（ Volodymyr Zelensky ）对美国与俄罗斯达成向全球市场释放大量柴油燃料的协议的批评时表示， “现在是乌克兰选出新总统的时候了”。

这位乌克兰总统警告说，这笔交易将为莫斯科提供资金，继续与他的国家进行战争，称这是给俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京的礼物。

特朗普周六在白宫外告诉记者，泽伦斯基“希望通过继续授权袭击俄罗斯炼油厂来为世界制造问题”。“他最好停下来，”特朗普说，然后建议乌克兰应该“得到一个可以达成协议的新领导人”。

包括柴油在内的全球燃料供应受到美国和以色列对伊朗发动的战争的严重限制，这导致霍尔木兹海峡的有效关闭，世界上大约五分之一的石油产品通常流经霍尔木兹海峡。

俄罗斯（一个主要生产国）和乌克兰最近加强了对彼此能源基础设施和运输设施的罢工，进一步加剧了能源市场的压力。

普京的特使基里尔·德米特里耶夫（ Kirill Dmitriev ）将特朗普的干预描述为“标志性和历史性的” ，称乌克兰“需要真正专注于和平的领导力”。

乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基（ Volodymyr Zelensky ）对该协议的反应是，它将允许莫斯科筹集新的资金，用于采购新的军事装备以继续战争。

Reeta Chakrabarti介绍了由Joe Inwood和Dan Johnson报道的BBC新闻。

articles.title: Cockroach protest leaders among hundreds detained in Delhi crackdown | BBC News
articles.titleZh: 在德里镇压中被拘留的数百名蟑螂抗议领导人| BBC新闻
articles.summary:
Hundreds of protesters have been detained in Delhi during the latest demonstration by the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) calling for electoral reforms.

The group said its founder Abhijeet Dipke - who launched the movement in May after India's Chief Justice likened some jobless young people to "cockroaches" - was detained with other leaders shortly after landing in Delhi.

Tens of thousands of security personnel were deployed and roads barricaded ahead of the demonstration. 

The group - who are not registered as a political party in India - are seeking electoral reforms just months before key state elections. It has also demanded the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over allegations of manipulating voters' lists, which the Election Commission has denied.

Under Kumar's leadership, India's election commission has carried a vast exercise to update electoral rolls nationwide. It says this was a routine exercise to remove the names of dead, duplicate or ineligible voters. But in many states the exercise has been shrouded in controversy, with tens of thousands of people alleging they have been wrongly removed.

The CJP and opposition parties accuse Kumar of manipulating the process in order to benefit Prime Minister Narendra Modi's governing Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).  The Election Commission and the BJP have denied this.

Reeta Chakrabarti presents BBC News at Ten reporting by Azadeh Moshiri in Delhi.

Subscribe to our channel here: https://bbc.in/bbcnews

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news

articles.readingTextZh:
在蟑螂党（ CJP ）呼吁选举改革的最新示威活动中，数百名抗议者在德里被拘留。

该组织表示，其创始人阿比吉特·迪普克（ Abhijeet Dipke ）在印度首席大法官将一些失业的年轻人比作“蟑螂”后于5月发起了这场运动，他在抵达德里后不久就与其他领导人一起被拘留。

在示威活动之前，数万名安全人员被部署，道路被封锁。

该组织尚未在印度注册为政党，正在关键州选举前几个月寻求选举改革。

它还要求首席选举专员Gyanesh Kumar因操纵选民名单的指控而辞职，选举委员会否认了这一指控。

在库马尔的领导下，印度选举委员会开展了一项大规模的工作，在全国范围内更新选民名册。

它说，这是一项例行公事，旨在删除已死亡、重复或不合格选民的姓名。

但在许多州，这项工作一直笼罩在争议中，成千上万的人声称他们被错误地删除了。

CJP和反对党指责库马尔操纵这一进程，以使总理纳伦德拉·莫迪（ Narendra Modi ）执政的印度人民党（ Bharatiya Janata Party ， BJP ）受益。

选举委员会和人民党否认了这一点。

Reeta Chakrabarti在德里报道了Azadeh Moshiri的BBC新闻。

articles.title: Russian glide bomb attack on Zaporizhzhia kills at least 15 people | BBC News
articles.titleZh: 俄罗斯对扎波罗热的滑翔弹袭击造成至少15人死亡| BBC新闻
articles.summary:
Russia has attacked the Ukrainian city of Zaporizhzhia with five glide bombs, killing at least 15 people including three children, according to officials.
 
The glide bombs hit residential buildings in the south-eastern city on Saturday morning. At least 16 others were injured in the attack, with more still missing and believed to be under the rubble.
 
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said the attacks on Zaporizhzhia were Russia expressing "its thanks" for a deal announced by US President Donald Trump last night easing sanctions on Moscow to import Russian diesel.

articles.readingText:
Russia has attacked the Ukrainian city of Zaporizhzhia with five glide bombs, killing at least 15 people including three children, according to officials.

The glide bombs hit residential buildings in the south-eastern city on Saturday morning.

At least 16 others were injured in the attack, with more still missing and believed to be under the rubble.

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said the attacks on Zaporizhzhia were Russia expressing "its thanks" for a deal announced by US President Donald Trump last night easing sanctions on Moscow to import Russian diesel.

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news

星期六早上，滑翔炸弹袭击了东南部城市的住宅楼。

至少有16人在袭击中受伤，更多人仍然失踪，据信在瓦砾下。
